payload.text: IN THE AGENT'S ZSH, `$R:lib/x` IS `$R` WITH THE `:l` MODIFIER (lowercase) FOLLOWED BY `ib/x` (vc, 2026-10-08). `git show $R:lib/install` asked git for `d7f2ed13ib/install`, every lookup failed, and a `grep -c` over the failed output printed 0, which read as an answer until a control on main printed 1. `$R:bin/...` happened to work, which is why it looked like a typo. Write `${R}:path`, or run the block under bash; and print the status beside every zero, per LESSONS.
